disclaimer: All resources listed here are independent third-party educational platforms and tools. They are curated strictly for foundational cybersecurity skill development and are NOT endorsed by or affiliated with IIT Kanpur or IIT Madras as an official examination syllabus.

resources.name: OverTheWire: Bandit Wargame
resources.handsOnTask: Progressively solve Levels 0 through 15 using Linux terminal commands (ssh, grep, find, base64, tr, diff). Document each solution command in a personal markdown file.
resources.learningOutcome: Fluency in Linux command-line navigation, file permissions, pipes, text filtering, and remote secure shell operation.
resources.disclaimer: Independent educational wargame. Not part of any official entrance test syllabus.

resources.name: PortSwigger Web Security Academy (Apprentice Labs)
prerequisites: Basic understanding of HTTP requests and responses
resources.handsOnTask: Complete the 'Apprentice' interactive labs for SQL Injection, Authentication, and Directory Traversal. Inspect raw HTTP requests and responses using a web intercepting proxy.
resources.learningOutcome: Deep understanding of client-server HTTP communication, query parameter manipulation, and common web security vulnerability vectors.
resources.disclaimer: Independent interactive learning academy. Not part of any official entrance test syllabus.

resources.name: PicoCTF Platform (Practice Gymnasium)
resources.handsOnTask: Solve 10 beginner-tier jeopardy challenges across General Skills, Cryptography, and Forensics. Publish 2 detailed technical writeups to your personal GitHub repository.
resources.learningOutcome: Familiarity with Capture The Flag (CTF) tournament mechanics, hex editors, string extraction, and methodical flag hunting under laboratory constraints.
resources.disclaimer: Independent academic CTF training platform. Not part of any official entrance test syllabus.

resources.name: Beej's Guide to Network Programming
prerequisites: Basic C programming or Python socket familiarity
resources.handsOnTask: Read Chapters 1 through 6. Implement a minimal working TCP echo client and server that handles binary message framing and gracefully handles socket timeouts.
resources.learningOutcome: Mastery of low-level socket APIs, IP addressing, byte ordering, TCP three-way handshakes, and packet transport fundamentals.
resources.disclaimer: Independent technical programming guide. Not part of any official entrance test syllabus.

resources.name: CyberChef: The Cyber Swiss Army Knife
prerequisites: Familiarity with base encodings (Base64, Hex, URL encoding)
resources.handsOnTask: Construct multi-operation recipes to decode nested data formats, compute cryptographic hashes (SHA-256, MD5), and analyze XOR-encrypted bitstreams.
resources.learningOutcome: Intuitive understanding of data encoding transformations, symmetric encryption operations, and rapid triage of suspicious byte patterns.
resources.disclaimer: Independent open-source utility. Not part of any official entrance test syllabus.
